applies: All five new arms/three seeds, separately to native and corrected archived logits at unchanged corrected-selected checkpoints; equal fitting labels, folds, optimizer and fixed endpoint.
operator: One positive scalar T per bank/readout/fold, common across its actual members; log p_m=log_softmax(Z_m or S_m); calibrated log p_m=log_softmax(log p_m/exp(log_T)); calibrated log pool=logsumexp_m(calibrated log p_m)-log M. Not per-member T or post-pool scaling.
objective: NLL of the calibrated probability-mean bank on fold-complement VALID rows only; no penalty
fit: Exactly500 full-batch CPU float64 Adam updates; lr.01, betas(.9,.999), eps1e-8, weight_decay0; retain final update, no early stopping, rate/temperature grid or alternative calibrator selection.
folds: Use identical ordered VALID rows across banks; existing fixed local CPU torch.Generator seed11709 randperm; permutation position modulo5; labels never choose folds. Hash ordered IDs and fold assignment. For each fold fit four-fifths and emit only held-fifth probabilities; stitch five folds.
endpoint_scope: OOF calibration diagnostic on encountered development. Base checkpoint selection already used all VALID labels, so post-selection folds are not fresh validation or whole-pipeline cross-fitting.
native_and_corrected_authority: Preserve raw float32 class logits/member and probability-mean decisions; stable raw NLL authoritative. Show all raw native/corrected accuracy/NLL before secondary calibration. No calibrated result overwrites raw archives, criterion or selector.
no_selector_or_TRAIN_change: No calibration during native fitting/checkpoint selection; no gradient into bodies/correctors; no TRAIN objective change; no TEST access.
no_final_refit: No all-VALID temperature refit, deployable fresh-data claim or later candidate choice follows from this diagnostic.
frozen_old_decoder: Complete30-fit recurrent decoder remains failed/closed; this policy is prospective for the new recipe and neither rescues nor retunes it.
failure: Preserve every nonfinite/failed calibration endpoint; no implicit retry or candidate replacement.
metrics: Secondary accuracy/NLL/Brier, fitted T and ordinary repair/harm counts; member order/any-member coverage invariant under each positive T, while pooling ranks may change. Separate confidence utility from new correct-alternative acquisition.
root_gates: Root chooses new-study primary utility gates before qualification/training; calibration is secondary evidence only.
